description_en: Queries the information about a resource directory. If the management account calls this operation, the details of the resource directory enabled by the management account are returned. If a member calls this operation, the details of the resource directory to which the member belongs are returned
description_zh: 调用GetResourceDirectory获取资源目录信息。管理账号调用时，返回管理账号开通的资源目录详情。成员调用时，返回成员所属的资源目录详情
name: GetResourceDirectory

ControlPolicyStatus.description_en:
The status of the control policy. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.
PendingEnable: Being enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.
PendingDisable: Being disabled
ControlPolicyStatus.description_zh:
管控策略状态。取值：

Enabled：已开启。
PendingEnable：开启中。
Disabled：已关闭。
PendingDisable：关闭中

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource directory was enabled. The time is displayed in UTC in RFC 3339 format, indicated by Z
CreateTime.description_zh: 资源目录开通时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

IdentityInformation.description_en: The real-name verification information of the member

MasterAccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account

MasterAccountName.description_en: The name of the management account

MemberDeletionStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether member deletion is enabled. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled. You can call [DeleteAccount]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311546.html） to delete members of the resource account type.
Disabled: Disabled. You cannot delete members of the resource account type
MemberDeletionStatus.description_zh:
是否开启了成员删除许可。取值：
Enabled：已开启。允许通过调用[DeleteAccount]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311546.html）删除资源账号类型的成员。
Disabled：已关闭。不允许删除资源账号类型的成员

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

RootFolderId.description_en: The ID of the Root folder
